ESP32 Wi-Fi CSI Research Project

Wi-Fi CSI Signal Validation Report

Experiment: 1-Minute Empty Room vs. 1-Minute Person Walking Capture
Hardware: Ali Board (TX Broadcast @ 60 Hz, Ch 11) → Sabi Board (RX Station UDP Stream)
Receiver Sample Rate: 58.7 packets/sec | Active Subcarriers: 116 tones

1. Raw CSI Data Comparison (Before Cleaning)

The raw Channel State Information represents the raw complex Channel Frequency Response (CFR) across OFDM subcarriers directly from baseband hardware:

Figure 1: Raw CSI Amplitude for Empty Room (top) vs. Person Walking (bottom).
  • Static DC Offset: Both traces ride on a massive DC baseline (~35–42 ADC units) caused by stationary Line-of-Sight (LoS) propagation and wall reflections.
  • Thermal Jitter: In the Empty Room, signals show high-frequency electronic noise (±1–2 ADC units) without rhythmic structure.
  • Multipath Modulation: During walking, constructive and destructive RF interference creates macroscopic wave swings (Δ ~10–15 ADC units) and an RSSI shift from -74.5 dBm to -71.1 dBm.

2. Final Cleaned CSI Data Comparison (After 6-Stage Pipeline)

Applying the 6-stage signal cleaning pipeline strips static bias, eliminates packet jitter, and isolates human Doppler gait waveforms:

Figure 2: Final Cleaned CSI Motion Profile (PC1) for Empty Room (top) vs. Person Walking (bottom).
Parameter Empty Room Person Walking Physical / DSP Explanation
Baseline Center 0.00 0.00 Static DC carrier stripped by 0.2 Hz highpass Butterworth filter.
Motion Energy (σ) 8.62 11.45 Human movement injects substantial Doppler variance across subcarriers.
Peak-to-Peak Amplitude Quiet baseline 74.50 (Coherent) Walking produces rhythmic, sustained multipath phase crests.
Waveform Morphology Random residual noise Periodic Doppler gait cadence Clear footstep cycles occurring at 1.2–2.5 Hz.

3. 6-Stage DSP Cleaning Pipeline Summary

Stage 1: Complex Parsing & Subcarrier 0 Removal
Decodes signed IQ bytes to magnitude sqrt(I² + Q²) and discards subcarrier 0 to remove AGC settling transients.
Stage 2: Dead Guard & DC Null Masking
Detects and eliminates 11 unmodulated tones (channels [27..35, 94, 96]), leaving 116 active communication subcarriers.
Stage 3: Vectorized Hampel Outlier Despiking
Computes rolling Median Absolute Deviation (MAD, window=7) to strip random RF transmission bursts and packet corruption spikes.
Stage 4: Zero-Phase Butterworth Bandpass Filter (0.2 Hz – 10.0 Hz)
Removes stationary DC multipath reflections and suppresses high-frequency thermal noise > 10 Hz, isolating human Doppler shifts.
Stage 5: Multi-Subcarrier Spatial PCA Fusion
Performs SVD across all 116 subcarriers to project coherent multi-channel motion energy into the dominant PC1 motion profile.
